query_interpretation.model_interpretation: Count of semaglutide trials started each year, grouped by trial phase using phase memberships.
plan_adjustments: The planning model revised its plan once after deterministic validation failed: Column(s) phase hold several values per trial and cannot be grouping keys. Use a memberships step with dimension 'phase' and group by its output column instead.

invariant.statement: Values count category memberships or collection entries; they must not be summed to infer unique trials.

meta.visualization_rationale: 22 time buckets show a trend over time.

notes.counting_rule: Values count category memberships or collection entries; they must not be summed to infer unique trials.
general: All values are extracted from trial records or computed deterministically from them.

meta.citation_policy: Citations are extracted mechanically from the ClinicalTrials.gov API response. Field values and excerpts are verbatim; the language model never writes them.
